$comment: ClickHouse MCP server for Claude Code. VERIFIED 30 Jul 2026 against mcp-clickhouse 0.4.1.
stdio is correct HERE (Claude Code runs on the host, which has a toolchain).
Do NOT use stdio from inside the LibreChat container - that image has no C compiler and
lz4 cannot build; use the streamable-http transport there instead. See docs/VERIFIED.md.
Tools exposed: list_databases, list_tables, run_query. run_chdb_select_query appears only
if the chdb extra is installed. The server enforces readonly itself: a write returns
Code: 164 even for a privileged user.
Env var names are CLICKHOUSE_MCP_*, NOT MCP_* - the latter are silently ignored.
